name: The World As It Was
source:
You’ve woken up in someone else’s skin and he’s been waiting for you. Spend a quiet, easy day with Arcturus. Together, walk through a day in his life and speak to the lovely cast that will eventually become your closest companions! 

[From [url=https://thereseu3u.itch.io/the-world-as-it-was]itch.io[/url]]

Part of the [url=https://www.tumblr.com/projecteidolon/790673060784209920/%EF%BD%90%EF%BD%92%EF%BD%8F%EF%BD%8A%EF%BD%85%EF%BD%83%EF%BD%94-%EF%BD%85%EF%BD%89%EF%BD%84%EF%BD%8F%EF%BD%8C%EF%BD%8F%EF%BD%8E]Project Eidolon[/url] series
translation:
你在别人的皮肤中醒来，他一直在等你。与Arcturus一起度过安静、轻松的一天。一起走过他生命中的一天，并与可爱的演员交谈，他们最终将成为你最亲密的伙伴！

[来自[url=https://thereseu3u.itch.io/the-world-as-it-was]itch.io[/url]]
